title: Solar System Installation (Final Year Project)
fullDescription:
Led the complete hardware design, load calculations, and physical implementation of a solar power system for the Department of Computer Science at Ambrose Alli University, Ekpoma.

### Key Highlights
- **Sustainable Energy**: Designed a reliable solar backup solution to power departmental computer hardware and lighting.
- **Technical Documentation**: Authored comprehensive installation manuals, wiring schematics, and maintenance guides for department staff.
- **Energy Management**: Conducted peak load audits to optimize battery capacity and inverter output efficiency.
